text: Flat bench every week... but your upper chest still looks flat?
Pressing on an incline lines up with your upper chest fibres, the ones just under your collarbone.
About thirty degrees is enough. Incline barbell for heavy weight, incline dumbbells for range, or an incline machine for stability.
Go too steep, and your shoulders take over. Put one incline press in every chest day.
Next up: chest flies. Save this.
